component.name: WackGet
component.summary: Download manager: paste or drop links and let it fetch them

description.p: WackGet is the classic 2002 download manager, rebuilt for today's computers and kept looking and working the way it always did. Copy links from anywhere, paste or drop them into the queue, and WackGet downloads them a few at a time, resuming partial files and retrying broken connections.

ul.li: Paste or drag and drop links, web pages and .wgq queue files; no browser add-on
Pause, force, requeue and reorder downloads; save and load queues
Resumes partial files and skips files that are already up to date
Tray icon showing download status, and a hot key to show or hide the window
Classic look, or the Windows 11 and Material Design 1 skins, light or dark

description.p: Rebuilt for Windows and Linux on x86-64 and ARM64, with a libcurl download engine.
